auth.two_step.intro: After your password, signing in will also ask for a code from an authenticator app on your phone (any app for time-based codes, also called TOTP). Someone who learns your password still cannot sign in.
auth.two_step.invalid_code: That code is not correct. App codes change every 30 seconds and each code works only once.
auth.two_step.login_hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
auth.two_step.manual_key: If you cannot scan it, enter this key in the app:

auth.two_step.renew_help: Each recovery code signs you in once if you lose your phone. New codes replace all the old ones.
auth.two_step.renewed: New recovery codes made. The old ones no longer work.
